notes.title: ‼️Foodomina Demo is OUT NOW‼️✨️🍕
notes.notes:
[h1]ᯓ✦ Hey gamers! BIG NEWS-[/h1] 

[h3]The time is finally here to take the Foodomina Demo out of the oven!💫[/h3]

It was cooking for quite a while, we hope it was worth the wait! Takoyaki & Tempura are ready for their big debut on your device! Oh- and Zygo too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/1a916f05dd0877a9cebd86184f0c950d8f443eef.gif[/img]              [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/06052841499986bbf4a5ec88835d99495c77fa7e.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/78b8b48583fdf4abd5500d4957c2c2df72ddb40b.gif[/img]


Here's some snacks for you all before we jump into this whimsical cosmic adventure ୧ ‧₊˚ 🍿☕️ ⋅ ☆

For any newcomers or those who need a reminder, this is what Foodomina is about!

✩₊˚.⋆☾⋆⁺₊✧
[previewyoutube=HqJ-Jhyeyls;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










✩₊˚.⋆☾⋆⁺₊✧

Foodomina is a Morally Layered, Food vs Mold themed RPG, where you play as 2 personified food girls & fight... MOLD people? In space! 🌌✨️
Explore a whimsical, galactic food-themed society that's rich in flavour, and engage in absurd, pun-fueled combat to save the galaxy from Mold infection! 🍤💫

[h3] ☄️KEY GAME FEATURES[/h3]
▪︎ Adventure 🚀
Adventure through space, cute towns, creepy laboratories, and the fantastical landscapes of food themed planets! 🪐 Engage with characters, learn their stories, and collect items... & snacks! 🍫🍕✨️

▪︎ Defend 👾🔫
Defend yourself against MOLD Enemies in battle, to avoid becoming infected! Strategise by equipping different combat abilities & items 💥✨️

▪︎ Cure 💜✨️
Endure a barrage of food puns when interacting with Mold Enemies. Puns are key to knowing what cure to apply for reversing Mold Infection...


[h3]☄️ IN THE DEMO... YOU CAN[/h3]

Play two game modes that give you a glimpse into what you can look forward to:

💫STORY MODE💫
Roughly 30 minutes of gameplay, our Story Preview is a condensed version of the game's beginning. You can experience the main gameplay features we have to offer & a teaser into where Takoyaki & Tempura's journey will take you in the future! Great for people interested in getting to know the characters, exploring a few environments, Foodomina's lore, and cutscenes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/902b15049ab4c4093deda496f280a727b8c1e9c2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/59fcfae14e53375bd91f47e17b6742bd8129480a.gif[/img]

💫BATTLE MODE💫
If Story Mode doesn't satisfy your Turn Based Combat & Bullet Hell cravings, and you can endure the Food Puns... then BATTLE MODE is for you! Featuring 10 diverse Mold Battles, including a Final Boss, experience back to back battles with increasing chaos & challenge, against enemies with personalities that'll grow on you... like mold! You'll unlock combat abilities & items that are currently exclusive to Battle Mode!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/d67e80d6d2fcc6f1e23d8a094b4e56a15c1e7544.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/ebbc51bd933957a0bdd3ced5d14f6711bb977f7f.gif[/img]


We hope you enjoy! If you happen to play the demo, we would LOVE to hear your thoughts! At the end of each game mode you'll be given a QR code that will take you to a feedback form. Both game mode forms are rather short, with 4-5 questions, and only one is written feedback! ∘⋆․⊹․∘⟡˖*⊹

Have fun! ᯓ✦

notes.title: The first Foodomina Demo is coming to Steam MAY 16TH!
notes.notes:
ᯓ✦ Nice to meet you all. This also happens to be Lumelli Studios first community update to Steam.

[i]Here's a snack for your troubles: ୧ ‧₊˚ 🍿☕️ ⋅ ☆[/i]

It's ALMOST time for the Foodomina Demo to come out of the oven! On May 16th we hope its debut can satisfy those indie RPG cravings! Here's what to look forward to!

[previewyoutube=HqJ-Jhyeyls;full][/previewyoutube]

As it is customary for any first dev post, I think it's only fitting we introduce Foodomina once again for any newcomers!

✩₊˚.⋆☾⋆⁺₊✧

Foodomina is a morally layered, Food vs Mold themed RPG, where you play as two personified Food Girls, and fight Mold People... In SPACE! 🌌
Explore a whimsical, galactic food-themed society that's rich in flavour, and engage in absurd, pun-fuelled combat to save the galaxy from Mold infection! 🍤💫

[i]A sneaky glimpse into the premise...[/i]

In the galaxy Foodomina, where food-themed planets are populated by civilisations of personified food people- you play as Takoyaki & Tempura; two childhood friends & cosmos travellers. Traverse a galaxy filled with whimsy, glitter, & flavour. Help reunite the Food Planets, make food friends, and battle Mould People. 👾
Takoyaki and Tempura having prestigious space academy ranks, are responsible for protecting their planet and exterminating any Mold people-- despite knowing that the Mold people were once Food themselves. However, along their journey, they discover the unthinkable- shattering everything they believed. Will they stay committed to their mission of wiping this invasive species out of existence... or risk everything for another way? 🪐✨

☄️ [b]KEY GAME FEATURES[/b]

▪︎ Adventure 🚀
Adventure through space, cute towns, creepy laboratories, and the fantastical landscapes of food themed planets! 🪐 Engage with characters, learn their stories, and collect items... & snacks! 🍫🍕✨️

▪︎ Cure [or don't...]💜✨️

You can experience the main gameplay features we have to offer & a teaser into where Takoyaki & Tempura's journey will take you in the future! Great for people interested in getting to know the characters, exploring a few environments, Foodomina's lore, and cutscenes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45124156/a397772697a722b9251f8d28d24f64d73721392f.gif[/img]


💫BATTLE MODE💫 
If Story Mode doesn't satisfy your Turn Based Combat & Bullet Hell cravings, and you can endure the Food Puns... then BATTLE MODE is for you! Featuring 10 diverse Mold Battles, including a Final Boss, experience back to back battles with increasing chaos & challenge, against enemies with personalities that'll grow on you... like mold! ✩₊˚.⋆☾⋆⁺₊✧


Phew... that was a lot! Here's a drink: 🧋‧₊˚ ⋅

We hope you all enjoy the Demo once it's out![b] Please Wishlist[/b] so you can be notified when our beloved girls Tako & Tem are ready to debut on your device!  ∘⋆․⊹․∘⟡˖*⊹
